items.exampleEn: Does your cat get along with your dog?
items.exampleZh: 你的貓和你的狗處得好嗎？

items.exampleEn: It took her a long time to get over her fear of dogs.
items.exampleZh: 她花了很長的時間才克服對狗的恐懼。

items.exampleEn: The workers asked for more pay, and the boss finally gave in.
items.exampleZh: 員工要求加薪，老闆最後讓步了。

items.exampleEn: At the race, volunteers gave water out to the runners.
items.exampleZh: 賽跑時，志工把水分發給跑者。

items.exampleEn: Go ahead and start eating. Don't wait for me.
items.exampleZh: 你們先開動吧，不用等我。

items.exampleEn: This is the form. Please fill it in and hand it in today.
items.exampleZh: 這是表格，請填好後今天交回來。

items.exampleEn: At the zoo gate, a young man was handing maps out.
items.exampleZh: 動物園門口有個年輕人在發地圖。

items.sentenceEn: Did you hand the report in yesterday?

items.audioEn: It took my brother months to get over losing the final game.
items.audioZh: 我哥哥花了好幾個月才走出輸掉決賽的心情。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的哥哥怎麼了？
options: He quit the team the next week
He was unhappy for a long time

items.sentenceEn: It's easy to get along with our new neighbor.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的新鄰居很好相處。

items.sentenceEn: If you want to use my pen, go ahead.
items.sentenceZh: 如果你想用我的筆，請便。

items.stemEn: At the train station, some students ____ free newspapers to people walking by.
items.stemZh: 在火車站，有些學生把免費報紙分發給路過的人。

items.stemEn: Before you leave the hotel, please ____ your keys at the front desk.
items.stemZh: 離開飯店前，請把鑰匙交回櫃台。

items.passageEn: Mia was nervous on her first day at her new school, but she soon got along with her classmates. In science class, the teacher handed out a list of topics for a group report. Mia's group could not agree. Two boys wanted to write about the sea, but Mia wanted to write about birds. After a long talk, Mia gave in and said, "Fine, let's go ahead with the sea." The report caused some stress, but the group got an A. Finally, Mia got over her worry about the new school.
items.passageZh: Mia 第一天到新學校時很緊張，但她很快就和同學處得很好。自然課時，老師發下一份小組報告的主題清單。Mia 那組意見不合。兩個男生想寫海洋，但 Mia 想寫鳥類。討論了很久之後，Mia 讓步了，說：「好吧，我們就開始寫海洋吧。」這份報告帶來一些壓力，但小組拿到了 A。最後，Mia 不再擔心新學校的事了。

questions.questionZh: 老師在自然課發了什麼？
Mia 那組最後寫什麼主題？

items.promptZh: 我跟班上每個同學都處得很好。
referenceEn: I get along with everyone in my class.
I get along with all my classmates very well.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 get along with、get along well with 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 have a good relationship with、am on good terms with 等）也算對
「每個同學」可寫，例如 everyone in my class、all my classmates 等
「很好」可寫可不寫，例如 very well 等

items.promptZh: 我們問了爸爸很多次，但他就是不讓步。
referenceEn: We asked Dad many times, but he didn't give in.
We asked my dad many times, but he wouldn't give in.
We have asked Dad many times, but he still hasn't given in.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 give in 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 wouldn't change his mind、still said no 等）也算對
時態不限，例如 didn't give in、hasn't given in、won't give in、wouldn't change his mind 等
「爸爸」可寫，例如 Dad、my dad、my father 等
